sloka: लालप्यमानस्य विचेतनस्य ।प्रनष्ट बुद्धेः पतितस्य भूमौ ।मुहुर् मुहुर् निह्श्वसतः च दीर्घम् ।सा तस्य शोकेन जगाम रात्रिः ॥२-७५-६५॥
transliteration: lālapyamānasya vicetanasya ।pranaṣṭa buddheḥ patitasya bhūmau ।muhur muhur nihśvasataḥ ca dīrgham ।sā tasya śokena jagāma rātriḥ ॥2-75-65॥

translations.english: As he lamented, bereft of sense, his understanding lost, fallen upon the ground and sighing long again and again, that night of his passed in grief.
